headline: A AP-9, the endless business: Galicia pays to use it and could pay billions more to recover it
summary: Families bear increasingly expensive tolls on the AP-9 motorway, while the State finances bonuses. The Xunta warns recovering the concession could cost close to 4,000 million, with buyback above 2.3 billion.
why: AP-9 is a toll motorway concession in Galicia, Spain, and concession buybacks are public finance decisions. Large public liabilities affect regional budgets and infrastructure contracts.

original_headline: A AP-9, o negocio sen fin: Galicia paga por usala e podería volver pagar miles de millóns para recuperala
